sentences.text: Alberta occupational health reports covered significant uncontrolled hazards and poor occupational health and safety performance based on lost time claim rates, duration rates and WCB Poor Performance Surcharges.
Alberta occupational health and safety initiatives focused on workplace fatalities, serious incidents and complaints regarding occupational health and safety issues.

Alberta occupational health and safety reports addressed hazards in the forestry industry, hazards in the oil and gas industry, chemical and biological hazards, and occupational health and safety problems of small businesses.

Alberta occupational health reports covered workplace hazards including identification, communication and control of workplace hazards, maintenance of equipment in safe working order, proper labelling and storage of chemicals, and provision of Material Safety Data Sheets and proper labels for controlled substances.

Alberta occupational health services included investigation of work-related health problems and illnesses, provision of advice on the health effects of chemical and physical hazards, investigation of radiation problems, and inspection of X-ray facilities.
Alberta occupational health reports covered radiation hazards through the Radiation Health Branch which investigated radiation problems and enforced the Alberta Radiation Protection Act.

Alberta occupational health reports included analysis of workplace injury and disease literature and provided statistical information and research reports on occupational injuries and illnesses in Alberta.
